One day, in the old town market, he almost has his wallet stolen by a pickpocket named Shirato. synopsis: In a remote corner of another world where only the nobility can use magic, a thirty-something office worker is reincarnated as a villager named Ren (5 years old). He enjoyed a laid-back life in the countryside, until the Cruel Angels (Pretty Angels) took a liking to him... Even though he wanted to be lazy, he ended up playing hide-and-seek, reading to them, calming them down, and more from morning to night, all because he was so caring! One day, while he was trying to think of ways to be lazy, a monster suddenly appeared in the peaceful village. When the problem children were targeted, the usually unmotivated Ren unleashed a hidden power he had been hiding to avoid trouble! This is the heroic tale of a carefree reincarnated boy who, with a sense of relief, babysits (and saves the country)! (Source: Corona EX, translated)

synopsis: The World Rift—a giant line of water jets that divides the world in two. Eight years ago, an epic battle punctured a hole through the rift and strange creatures began to leak into the known world, making it so that the only ones who venture out to sea are fools and pirates. Cherry Blossom is one of these aspiring pirates, setting out to sea in order to find something important to him. Along the way, he crosses paths with Sun, a mysterious boy who holds the World Rift Tear, an amulet said to be the key to traversing the World Rift and discovering what lies beyond. Together, they set out into uncharted seas, inviting any grand adventures that awaits them!
